I've written the Team page feature as six files, but it hasn't been compiled or run. I could only create files in this session, so I couldn't open the fluent-html package to check its API or run anything.

**Files created** (in `./team/`):

- `team/routes.ts`: a Fastify plugin that sets up `GET /team`, `GET /team/members` (the live search) and `POST /team/members` (the invite). `requireAuth` runs before every one of these routes. You register it with `app.register(teamRoutes, { requireAuth })`.
- `team/handlers.ts`: builds the full page, the search results and the invite response. After a successful invite it sends back an empty form plus a refreshed member list, which HTMX swaps in on the same response.
- `team/views.ts`: the page, members section, search box, list, status badges, both empty states, and the invite form.
- `team/validation.ts`: reads the form input and checks that the name is filled in, the email is valid and not already on the team, and the role is one of the three allowed.
- `team/store.ts`: the in-memory store, seeded with three members.
- `team/layout.ts`: a basic HTML page wrapper that loads HTMX and Tailwind from public CDNs.
